title: Telangana government to set up CFC in Gachibowli,  tanneries in Karimnagar to bolster leather industry
description: CFC to extend support in design, product development and branding, the tanneries in Choppadandi mandal of Karimnagar will be eco-friendly and generate 1,000 jobs, says Minister Sridhar Babu after a review meet with TGLIPC officials
